description: Amaranth GrayEncoder(8), generated RTL (stand-in, not a Forge block). Two copies: enc1 sees enc0's input plus one, to check the unit-distance property.

properties.source: GrayEncoder doc: encode natural binary to Gray code; binary-reflected Gray code g(n) = n XOR (n >> 1)
Gray code property: consecutive values (mod 2^8, including 255 -> 0) differ in exactly one bit

bit_exact.claim: output equals n XOR (n >> 1) for every 8-bit input n
bit_exact.method: formal: SMT proof over all 2^8 inputs
